name_reason: Already compliant: fd2_ prefix, descriptor accurately states purpose (compute equipped stats with a hypothetical item preview). No address residue; no domain-ID suffix. Confirmed accurate against decomp + caller (fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview) + asm.
purpose: Compute a party member's [AP, DP, hit, evade] as if a candidate item were equipped, replacing the currently equipped same-category item, for the buy-menu side-by-side stat preview.
logic_summary: Resolves item_id to an item-effect entry; reads preview_cat = entry[0] (weapon <= 0x14, armor > 0x14). Seeds the 4 stats from the runtime char base (AP=combat_aux_block+0x10, DP=combat_aux_block+0x12, hit and evade both from ai_target_and_dx_block+1 = dx_total) plus the candidate item's bonuses (entry +1 AP, +3 hit, +5 DP, +7 evade). Then loops the char's 8 inventory slots; for each slot whose flag has bit 0x40 (equipped) AND whose category is the OPPOSITE side of the 0x14 split from the candidate, adds that item's same four bonuses. The same-category equipped item is deliberately skipped (the preview replaces it). Writes the 4 results as int32 to stats_out_ptr +0/+4/+8/+0xC. Pure compute; no writes to runtime char state.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_compute_equipped_stats_with_item_preview(uint32 char_idx, uint32 item_id, uint32 stats_out_ptr)

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (80-byte stride) selecting the party member to preview.
params.reason: Accurate and idiomatic; used purely as the runtime_char array index. No address residue.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Candidate item id; resolved via fd2_get_item_effect_entry to the item-effect entry whose bonuses are previewed.
params.reason: Matches usage exactly (forwarded verbatim from the caller's candidate item). Clear, no residue.

params.name: stats_out_ptr
params.semantics: Destination address for the 4 computed int32 stats [AP, DP, hit, evade] at +0/+4/+8/+0xC; caller passes &preview_ap.
params.reason: Name states it is the output pointer; matches the four stores. Held as uint32 address per this codebase's existing convention (not changing type per refine rules).

returns.semantics: No return value; results delivered through stats_out_ptr (4 int32: AP, DP, hit, evade).

comment_original_issue: src comment labelled the 4 outputs '[AP, DP, DX, Stat4]'; DX/Stat4 were imprecise placeholders. Confirmed via types.h (dx_current +0x4C = hit/accuracy, stat4_current +0x4E = evade/dodge) and caller field reads (wDX_current/wEvade) that stats 3 and 4 are hit and evade, both seeded from the single dx_total base and differing only by item bonus offset (+3 HT, +7 EV).
notes: Verified plate/decomp/src/asm all consistent: char base offsets +0x37/+0x39/+0x3e, item bonus reads at entry+1/3/5/7, category compare uses 0x14 (<= vs >, equivalent to plate's < 0x15 vs >= 0x15), inventory slot stride 2 with flag&0x40. The PUSH 0x2c / CALL is the compiler __CHK stack-probe (frame size 0x2c). Sole caller: fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview @ 0x2EBE0. No logic/equivalence concerns. Plate refined to confirm hit/evade semantics (was tentative 'presumably wDX/wEvade') and updated globals symbol name; saved to Ghidra.
